description: Live operational dashboard for the SharedMeta framework as exercised by the ClanWars stress example. Server-side meters (SharedMeta meter) + .NET runtime instrumentation (System.Runtime meter).

panels.title: Server RPC p95 by method (ms) — method body only
panels.description: Per-method series follow MetaTelemetryOptions.MethodMetrics; methods without their own series appear as <service>._other.

panels.title: Server-side total p50/p95/p99 (ms) — transport entry to response
panels.description: End-to-end at MetaConnectionHandler.RpcCallAsync: SessionManagerGrain queue + grain-hop + method body + response build. Gap vs the 'method body only' panel reveals queue / hop overhead. Reproduces client-perceived server latency without the network leg.

panels.title: RPC request / response bytes p95 by method
RPC errors/sec by method and error_kind
Query rate and p95 by method
Desyncs reported by kind
panels.description: Client desync reports; counted even when DesyncReportingEnabled is off. Any value > 0 deserves a look.

panels.title: Out-of-order RPCs: stashed/sec and drain wait p95
Session terminations/sec by reason
panels.description: A transport_drop spike with flat graceful = network incident; stash_overflow / stall = ordering problems.

panels.title: Requests/sec by transport and endpoint
panels.description: Canonical client RPS at the transport edge: every hub invocation / HTTP request, including Query, Signal, Subscribe, Ack, Poll.

panels.title: Endpoint p95 (ms)
panels.description: Long-poll endpoints are counted, not timed.

panels.title: Auth requests/sec by provider and result
Mux batch size p50/p95 (calls per hub invocation)
Cross-entity call rate by kind (Notification = OneWay)
Per-subscriber tailoring (path = patch reveals force-patch fires)
Avg subscribers per broadcast (sum / count)
panels.description: Mean fan-out per broadcast event, computed as histogram sum / count over the rate window. Complements the p50/p95 panel by showing the arithmetic mean — useful when a few popular entities (e.g. one huge clan) skew the distribution. Tagged by state_type.

title: SharedMeta / ClanWars
